_doc: Facts about a Lorcana playmat that TCGplayer's own listing does not carry.
Read by scripts/load_playmats.py; every field here WINS over what the rules derived.
Keyed by TCGplayer product id. 'set' is a set NAME exactly as it appears in the sets table.
'image' is a site-relative photo under Logos/playmats/, for a mat whose TCGplayer photo is not the mat.
Every entry carries a 'why' - this file is a record of decisions, not a patch list.
The rules already handle: (Champion)/(Participant) -> Set Championship with the set named in
TCGplayer's description; (Disney Lorcana Challenge) -> DLC; 'YYYY Convention Playmat' -> event;
'exclusively available on the Ravensburger Online Store' -> ravensburger; 'at Disney locations' ->
disney; and a retail mat's set from its street date. Add an entry only where none of that applies.
A Challenge mat's tier (Top Prize / Prize Wall) is never on TCGplayer: every one needs a ruling here.

510088.why: Same launch listing as 510085; lorcanaplayer files it as 'The First Chapter Maui Playmat'.
